text:
lana: Heads-up: need a concise battlecard + launch post tied to our new inference benchmark. Emphasis: predictable costs & fallbacks. Target publish + webinar in two weeks.
omar: Agree. Keep hero stat simple10x cost improvement is flashy but risky. Maybe '~3x lower unit cost in steady-state' + p95 latency improvement.
jin: I'll mock a hero image and a small benchmark appendix. Can someone confirm the test rig?
lana: Test rig: 8xA100 equiv, 2k seq workload, mixed batch sizes. I'll ask infra to confirm numbers and share CSV.
tara: For SDRs: need quick objection bullets (one-liners) and two email templates. Also include clear CTAs: dedicated trial + performance audit.
leo-sdr: Also want a short replayable demo flow for the webinar — 5m live compare and 3 takeaways for SDR follow-up.
ops-bot: (note) benchmark file uploaded: https://storage.redwood/bench/serve-econ-2024-v2.csv
omar: Draft claim for battlecard: "Same API, predictable serving economics." Short bullets: latency, cost, private deploy.
jin: Also add a tiny decision tree: "When to pick Redwood" (startup scale -> hosted; heavy-regulation -> private; big steady inference -> dedicated).
lana: Routing: webinar registrants -> if company_size>1000 OR job_title contains "Platform"/"Infra" -> AE; else SDR. EU leads flag -> EU queue.
tara: I'll write the 1-pg battlecard and the launch post draft. ETA: tomorrow morning.
leo-sdr: Can we get 3 short discovery questions to qualify: 1) current inference cost per 1M tokens? 2) latency targets? 3) need for private networks/KMS?
jin: Good. Also include a quick micro-benchmark chart snippet for the post (p50/p95 + cost/token).
omar: Tone: less engineering pedantry. Focus on business impact (unit economics, SLA risk reduction).
lana: Assignments: tara = battlecard + emails; jin = visuals + chart; omar = copy and webinar outline; leo-sdr = SDR playbook snippets and routing rules; lana = coordinate infra verification. Check-in 24h.
ops-bot: Reminder set: webinar date placeholder 2024-05-20.
leo-sdr: I'll draft the HubSpot rule and share in #marketing-ops.
tara: First drafts will land in the marketing drive: https://notion.redwood/marketing/launches/serve-econ-draft
lana: Thanks team. Keep claims tight and source numbers to infra CSV. We'll avoid absolute "10x" style claims. :sparkles:
